category: Hosted indexer aggregator (managed Prowlarr or NZBHydra 2 instance)

free_tier.stated: None free beyond a trial: 'USD 9.00 / month', 'Free trial: 7 days', 'Sign-up fee: USD 1.00', with 3/6/12-month terms at USD 25.65, 48.60 and 86.40. NZBHydra 2 is sold the same way.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an aggregator in front of indexers, not a store of objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the instance holds configuration, not content

interface_detail: A running Prowlarr or NZBHydra 2 served over HTTPS at a private link per user: 'On ElfHosted, it comes pre-configured and connected to your other apps.' The aggregator software itself is unchanged, so it speaks the same Newznab and Torznab API for a user.
tooling: Prowlarr and NZBHydra 2 are the tools; this is only a managed host for them. A client still supplies its own indexer accounts, so the aggregator does not remove the identity cost of any indexer.
chaining: Replaces a container a user would otherwise run: USD 9/month buys a running Prowlarr with no Docker, no reverse proxy and no TLS, and it then fans out to whatever indexers a user holds.

limits.value: paid app slot: USD 9/month after a 7-day trial and a USD 1 sign-up fee

binding_note: Payment is the gate: the instance does not start without a plan. Nothing in the seven-kind vocabulary describes a subscription, so write-gated is used for the access gate and the price is carried in extras.

identity_cost.detail: A paid order with a card and a USD 1 sign-up fee; a 7-day trial is offered first. Indexer accounts are separate and are a user's own.

reliability_note: A managed instance is somebody else's uptime: the aggregator going down stops every indexer at once, which a local install would not.
confidence_note: The price, trial and sign-up fee were read on the vendor's own product page today. The NZBHydra 2 product was seen in search results but its page was not opened.

evidence.proved: vendor page read today: 'USD 9.00 / month', 'Free trial: 7 days', 'Sign-up fee: USD 1.00', and 'On ElfHosted, it comes pre-configured and connected to your other apps.'
search snippet only: a managed NZBHydra 2 product exists alongside Prowlarr; the page itself was not opened
search snippet: 'ElfHosted hosts NZBHydra 2 as a managed open-source app'

extras.note: this is not an indexer; it is a host for the aggregator layer

notes: Brief asked for a hosted aggregator that needs no install: this is one, and it is paid. No free hosted aggregator was found. this record prices the hosting, which is a service.
